description: City reviews sump pump discharge issues in new developments.
Project seeks solutions for basements built in high groundwater.
Options include storm connections or city-led mitigation.
Industry feedback on solutions will be gathered this summer.

chips.text: Long-term groundwater monitoring (10+ years) is needed for accurate data.
Residents face saturated green spaces and icy sidewalks from sump pump discharge.
Unclear if city can force developers to disclose high groundwater levels to buyers.
Residents are frustrated by sump pump discharge issues, as seen on social media.
Sharing private groundwater data could lead to legal issues with developers.
Project will focus solely on solutions for future developments, not existing issues.
